## findings

1. **SOURCE-POLICY / SOURCE-TASK RED (from charter F7).** Symptom: second defensible refund. Root cause: drive-up small-order deduction applies the member Same-Day small-order fee after the order, contradicting membership_delivery_benefit ("This is the single statement of the membership delivery and return-pickup benefits that apply to Northgate orders" … "combine with … price adjustments … without interaction"). Evidence: membership c6167b98… (Northgate+ Monthly, same_day_free_min_order_usd 35.00, member_small_order_same_day_fee_usd 6.99), fee row d4db5e57… (0.00, waiver membership, standard 9.99), lines totalling 103.94. Consequence: 42.84 (gold) vs 49.83. Affected: extended charter drive-up rule (small-order sentence) and small_order_deduction_step; tasks/1.json computations[1]. First revision.
2. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED (from charter F1).** late_express lateness_rate_step (fall-through "otherwise the standard two fifths" unreachable: the credit is owed only when fulfilled ≥1 day late) and express_price_extra (fall-through "nothing added" = fee charged 0.00, whose credit is 0.00 and cannot be booked). Struck, the late-express computation keeps 2 factors (<4). Affected: extended charter ladders; tasks/1.json computations[0]. First revision.
3. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED (from charter F8).** late_delivery_relief bears weight here (T1: 38.59 vs 42.84) but cannot move the result in any producible world with the other factors at baseline (Same-Day program restocking 0% -> restocking floor 0.00), i.e. it is gated through category/hold/history. The drive-up computation still keeps 5 factors (2 method) without it. Affected: extended charter drive-up restocking sentence and late_delivery_relief. First revision.
4. Charter F4, F5, F6, F9, F10 are not engaged in this world (single adjustment on the returned line; kept merchandise 30.97 or 24.97, both below 35.00; one membership holding; express charged 10.00; no Northgate Cash or gift card on the order).
